mapper.select: SELECT id,source_id,identity_type,contact_ciphertext,contact_nonce,contact_tag,contact_key_id,contact_algorithm FROM t_feedback_identity WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND contact_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND contact_authorization_basis IN ('SDK_CONSENT','CHANNEL_GOVERNANCE') AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>NOW(3)) ORDER BY identity_type,id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id,source_id,identity_type,contact_ciphertext,contact_nonce,contact_tag,contact_key_id,contact_algorithm FROM ( SELECT i.id,i.source_id,i.identity_type,i.contact_ciphertext,i.contact_nonce,i.contact_tag, i.contact_key_id,i.contact_algorithm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY source_id ORDER BY identity_type,id) AS source_row_number FROM t_feedback_identity i WHERE source_id IN #{sourceId} AND contact_ciphertext IS NOT NULL AND contact_authorization_basis IN ('SDK_CONSENT','CHANNEL_GOVERNANCE') AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at>NOW(3)) ) bounded WHERE source_row_number<=#{perSourceLimit} ORDER BY source_id,identity_type,id
